Name: Hearth and Home for Buildable Kitchen
Author: hypnagogie
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/59cPwMum.png[/img][center]﻿[/center]
This is a cozy modern farmhouse kitchen texture pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11950]Aster's Buildable Kitchen[/url], adapted from my Hearth & Home collection, with several customizable options.

[list]
[*]5 cabinet/shelf colors 
[*]2 counter types
[*]6 stove colors (that coincidentally coordinate with the kitchen mixers & dutch ovens in the furniture mod)
[*]3 types of metal fixtures
[/list]
Fun fact - "Amboine" is a French wood that I found using a reverse google image search after I accidentally made a beautiful wood texture that I fell in love with and couldn't matchto any real-world wood that I knew of.  Maybe I remembered it from a past life.
[b]
Other packs in this collection [/b](all of which are previewed in the screenshots)

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18496]Kitchen for Content Patcher[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18478]Walls & floors
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18487]Furniture[/url]

[b]Installation[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Download & install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11950]Aster's Buildable Kitchen[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]DGA[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod[/url]﻿, & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Spacecore[/url]﻿
[*]Download this mod!
[*]﻿Unzip and move all of that to your [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Find_your_game_folder]Stardew Valley Mods folder[/url]
[*]Run the game
[/list]
[b]Using Alternative Textures in game
[/b]
[list]
[*]You'll need to go to Robin's and buy a paint bucket (there are a few other tools, too, but not absolutely necessary).
[*]Place the default item (e.g. the blue armchair) in the world.
[*]With the paint bucket equipped, click on the item you want to retexture.
[*]Use the keyword "hnh" to find options from this pack.
[*]Play!
[/list]
